title: Immersive Reader Publication v1
description: publication.json sidecar written next to manifest.json for non-Markdown books (currently EPUB). Mirrors Publication/NavItem in apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/epub.rs and parsePublication in src/index.ts. Cross-field rules that JSON Schema cannot express — nav chapterId ⊆ spine — live in the validators (Rust validate_publication, TS parsePublication).

epubVersion.description: Major version of the OPF package document.

spine.description: Spine order as chapter ids; mirrors manifest.chapters order.

resources.description: Manifest item id → book-relative path inside the book dir.

relativePath.description: Forward-slash relative path; every segment must be non-empty, not . or .., free of \ NUL : < > | ? *, not a reserved device basename (CON/PRN/AUX/NUL/COM1-9/LPT1-9 case-insensitively, before the first .), and not end in . or space. Mirrors isSafeRelativePath (TS) and is_safe_relative_path (Rust).
